description.narrative: Australia-Malaysia Reform Partnership (AMRP) between DFAT and The Asia Foundation (TAF) is the successor program to the Malaysia and Thailand Reform Partnerships. The AMRP is a small, flexible program aimed at supporting meaningful progress on policy reforms in Malaysia which will be critical for maintaining inclusive growth and stability. Acknowledging that reform in priority policy areas is complex and takes time, the AMRP will ensure that important reforms we commenced during the MTRP continue and can be deepened, as well as allowing for new areas of reform cooperation to be explored. AMRP focus areas include supporting Care Economy reforms to boost women's workforce participation, and Blue Economy initiatives in Sabah.

title.narrative: Economic policy reform and management and private sector development

description.narrative: The Australia-Malaysia Reform Program (AMRP), implemented by The Asia Foundation, contributes to policy reforms in areas which are critical for maintaining inclusive growth, such as increasing women’s labour force participation. AMRP is supporting Malaysia’s efforts to improve and professionalise its care industry, as one of the key reasons women in Malaysia leave the workforce is due to childcare responsibilities and a lack of quality care options. ‍ Through close collaboration with the Ministry of Women, Family and Community Development (KPWKM), the Selangor State Government and other stakeholders, AMRP has supported the development of several policy roadmaps to improve Malaysia’s care economy. At the national level, AMRP co-developed a new Care Industry Policy Roadmap Framework with KPWKM. The roadmap was drafted following a multi-agency policy workshop to identify policy solutions to address key issues surrounding the quality and accessibility of care. ‍ At the state level, AMRP provided technical support in the development of the 2024-2030 Selangor State Care Economy Policy Framework, which was passed by the State Legislative Assembly in November 2024. The policy integrates the roles of the state government, communities, and the private sector to promote sustainable economic development.
